Corpus v4 carried that role here by reading the passage body; document-level roles lost it, and the probe `Sécurité rénale avant cisplatine` caught the loss -- its note says dossier 2 turns on it, an 85-year-old with a clearance of 30. Carries `safety_reviewer` as well: eligibility for a drug the patient cannot clear is harm guidance, and a safety reviewer that cannot see the cisplatin fork cannot review a bladder case.
